mechanism: Gemfibrozil inhibits CYP3A4 and CYP2C8, increasing valbenazine and its active metabolite NBI-98854 plasma concentrations, potentially enhancing CNS effects and adverse reactions.
action: Monitor for increased valbenazine adverse effects (somnolence, akathisia, parkinsonism); consider dose reduction of valbenazine or alternative fibrate if clinically feasible.
